summary: Iteration 129 - Restaurant Table System with Digital Service Buttons Testing Complete. All 22 backend API tests PASSED. Frontend UI verified: Admin Tables page (/admin/tables) with CRUD, QR generation, print/copy functions. Public Guest page (/table/:tableId) with digital service buttons (Service rufen, Rechnung anfordern), menu display, cart functionality. Staff Dashboard (/staff/dashboard) with open orders, active service calls, wait times, action buttons. Kitchen Monitor (/kitchen) with order status groups (new/accepted/preparing/ready) and tap-to-advance workflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend restaurant_table_system.py is well-structured with proper async/await patterns
All table CRUD endpoints properly validate user authentication
Service call creation (digital buttons) works without auth - correct for public guest access
Table status automatically updates based on open orders/service calls/bill requests
Printer slip generation uses file fallback when no hardware printer is configured (acceptable for preview)
Frontend pages have proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Digital service buttons (Kellner rufen, Rechnung anfordern) work correctly from guest page
Staff dashboard shows live service calls with accept/done actions
Kitchen monitor shows orders grouped by status with tap-to-advance workflow
seed_data_creation: Test tables created with TEST_ prefix during backend testing, automatically cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 129 Restaurant Table System verified. Key clarification: The Service-Button is DIGITAL (not hardware). Guests scan QR code → open /table/:tableId → click digital buttons (Service rufen, Rechnung anfordern) → ServiceCall created in backend → Staff Dashboard receives live notification. No wireless button, no gateway, no external hardware needed. Backend endpoints: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/tables, POST /api/tables/:id/generate-qr, GET /api/tables/:id/menu (public), POST /api/orders, GET /api/orders, PUT /api/orders/:id/status, POST /api/service-call (public - for digital buttons), GET /api/service-call, PUT /api/service-call/:id/status, POST /api/button-webhook (for optional physical buttons), POST /api/tables/:id/bill-link. Frontend pages: /admin/tables (admin CRUD), /table/:tableId (public guest page with digital buttons), /staff/dashboard (staff view), /kitchen (kitchen monitor).

table_crud.details: Create, read, update, delete tables working. Button-ID uniqueness enforced.

qr_generation.details: QR code generation, copy link, print QR all working from admin page

public_guest_page.details: Guest page loads menu, shows table info, digital service buttons work

digital_service_buttons.details: Service rufen (Kellner rufen), Rechnung anfordern buttons create ServiceCalls in backend

order_creation.details: Cart functionality works, order submission creates order in backend

staff_dashboard.details: Shows open orders, service calls, bills, problems with action buttons (Annehmen, Erledigt, Rechnung bringen)

kitchen_monitor.details: Shows orders grouped by status (new/accepted/preparing/ready), tap-to-advance workflow

bill_link_generation.details: Bill link endpoint creates InvoicePay link when open orders exist

button_webhook.details: Webhook endpoint resolves button_id to table and creates service call (for optional physical buttons)

printer_slip.details: Printer slip generation uses file fallback when no hardware printer configured (acceptable for preview)

important_clarification: The Service-Button is 100% DIGITAL in the Web-App. No external hardware needed. Flow: QR-Code scan → Digital table page → Digital buttons (Kellner rufen, Rechnung anfordern, Nachbestellen, Problem melden) → ServiceCall in Backend → Staff Dashboard live notification → Optional thermal printer slip.
